journey.name: AC-14 - Resposta ilegível consulta a Cielo antes de cobrar de novo
journey.description: Mesmo pré-requisito da J1. Execução: skill android-cli (Journeys); lio-emulator 1.61.8 no AVD Android 10. Limpe o pedido abandonado do emulador antes (am force-stop br.com.cielosmart.orderservice).

actions.action: Open the Bilheteria app, tap "Noite de Jazz no Parque" and tap "Pagar R$ 80,00 no terminal"
In the Cielo emulator, complete the payment so that the app receives a response it cannot read
Verify the screen "Compra" shows the payment being confirmed with Cielo and does not offer a button to pay again
Verify that, after the lookup finds no order for this purchase, the screen shows the "not found" error with a button to try again
